verdict.rationale: Dover documents a public API and a machine-readable spec at app.dover.com/docs/api.json. Nothing in the evidence mentions API version numbers, versioned endpoints, or a deprecation or sunset policy. Having an API spec is adjacent to this story and does not show that versioning or deprecation guarantees exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
